description: This file defines a SupabaseClient class that provides methods for user authentication and note management, acting as a stub implementation for interacting with Supabase backend services. It includes functions for registering, logging in, and CRUD operations for notes, as well as fetching folders and tags. The implementation is currently placeholder, with comments indicating where real Supabase SDK logic should be integrated.

classes.name: SupabaseClient
classes.description: Client interface for interacting with Supabase for authentication and storage. Contains methods for user registration, login, and note operations.

methods.name: dict register_user(self, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Registers a new user in Supabase Auth, returning a dict with user ID and email.

methods.name: dict login_user(self, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user and returns an access token.

methods.name: List[dict] get_notes(self, user_id: str, folder_id: Optional[str]=None, tag_id: Optional[str]=None, search: Optional[str]=None)
methods.description: Fetches notes for a user, optionally filtered by folder, tag, or search term.

methods.name: dict create_note(self, user_id: str, note_data: dict)
methods.description: Creates a new note for a user with provided data.

methods.name: dict update_note(self, user_id: str, note_id: str, note_data: dict)
methods.description: Updates an existing note with new data.
